intro.title: Container With Most Water
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that solves the 'Container With Most Water' problem, a classic algorithm challenge. You will learn to find the maximum area of water that can be contained between vertical lines represented by an array of heights. The core concept is the two-pointer technique, an efficient approach for scanning arrays from both ends. Using JavaScript, you will implement this algorithm with basic loops, conditional logic, and mathematical calculations. By the end, you will understand how to optimize solutions by reducing time complexity from a brute-force method to a linear scan.
intro.usecase: The Container With Most Water algorithm solves optimization problems where you need to find maximum capacity between boundaries, similar to how UI layout engines calculate optimal spacing between elements. In responsive web design, this pattern helps determine the best dimensions for content containers, image galleries, or dashboard panels to maximize visible area while maintaining proportions. Frontend developers use variations of this approach when implementing dynamic resizing features in data visualization tools, video players, or collaborative whiteboard applications where available space must be utilized efficiently.
